about: The smoke set: the test-window runs every branch's last stage makes with lbterm.ps1 e2e -Smoke, beside the scripts the branch added or changed (Lachlan's 1a of 2026-11-09). Each guards a break that would cost him most in his daily LBTerm, runs in under about a minute, and never failed on the PC's account in the history (.claude/tools/e2e-history.ts). Entries are run names exactly as lbterm.ps1 e2e names them (a script, or a script and its variant's suffix), so naming a script doesn't bring its variants. About 5 minutes when they pass.

scripts.name: mux
scripts.why: his tabs live in the mux server: a tab's state reaches the GUI, survives a killed GUI, comes back on attach

scripts.name: mux-reconnect
scripts.why: the server hanging up or dying: the window reconnects and keeps its tabs, or gives up and closes

scripts.name: server-start
scripts.why: starting the server: one server, never two, never a GUI waiting on nothing

scripts.name: socket-keep
scripts.why: the server keeps its socket, which every project reaching his tabs goes through

scripts.name: restore
scripts.why: crash restore brings his tabs back

scripts.name: echo-frame
scripts.why: a key's echo in the first frame after it: typing arriving in bursts is what he notices first

scripts.name: echo-frame-mux
scripts.why: the same through the mux server, as his tabs are

scripts.name: claude-working
scripts.why: reading real Claude Code's screen: a stand-in passed while the scroll strip was wrong (2026-10-28)

scripts.name: scroll-strip
scripts.why: the scroll strip against a Claude transcript

scripts.name: spawn-no-activate
scripts.why: nothing LBTerm opens takes the foreground: a window that does swallows his typing

scripts.name: last-tab
scripts.why: the last tab closing, the window and the Conductor's pad

scripts.name: gpu-lost
scripts.why: a lost GPU device: the window rebuilds and keeps its panes (a driver update destroyed a window with every pane, 2026-08-11)
